user.title: Casa Mia app
user.description: Address of the Casa Mia app on the Supervisor network. Leave it empty to use the app found here ({found}); otherwise paste the Integration URL from the foot of the Casa Mia panel's home page (it is also in the app's log).

error.cannot_connect: The Casa Mia app did not answer at that address.
error.not_found: No Casa Mia app was found here: type its address (the Integration URL at the foot of the Casa Mia panel's home page, or in the app's log).

abort.already_configured: Casa Mia is already set up.

init.title: Casa Mia
init.description: The code the alarm panel asks for when arming and disarming (until one is set, the panel refuses both), and the dashboard helpers Casa Mia loads into Home Assistant.

data.script_streams: Keep camera pictures live (and the Security look)

data_description.script_streams: Stops the camera streams of pages not on screen and restarts those shown, so a page you come back to has a live picture; and gives the camera pictures the Security look while the Camera Commander's Security look switch is on.
data_description.script_back: The camera dashboard's Back buttons need it. Switch it on once any copy added by hand (nav_back_helper.js among the dashboard resources) is removed, or Back goes back twice.
data_description.script_refresh: Wall tablets show a deployed dashboard without a reload. Replaces auto_refresh.js among the dashboard resources: remove that one when switching this on.

alarm_no_code.message: No alarm code is set. Set one in the Casa Mia integration's options.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Casa Mia

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Casa Mia integration was updated from {from_version} to {to_version}, but Home Assistant is still running {from_version}. Until it restarts, nothing new in {to_version} works: new devices and entities (such as the Camera Commander's Main camera, which the commander's taps use) do not exist yet. Restart Home Assistant to load it.

api_mismatch.title: Casa Mia app and integration disagree
api_mismatch.description: The app speaks API {app_api} but this integration expects API {expected_api}. Update the app and the integration together.

send_sms.name: Send text
send_sms.description: Send a text message through the FONA.

enable_for.name: Open for a time
enable_for.description: Open a guest or engineer login endpoint, then close it again after the given time.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the endpoint stays open (1 to 1440).
